articles.description: Phrase of the Day: The phrase 'hit rock bottom' describes reaching life's lowest or most difficult point. This expression originates from mining and drilling, signifying a point of no return. It is used for serious setbacks, not minor daily disappointments or inconveniences. Many people find resilience and growth after experiencing such challenging moments. This phrase highlights the human belief that difficult times can initiate a fresh start.

articles.title: Adhik Jyeshtha, Super El Niño combo may delay Maharashtra monsoon, analysis flags higher rain deficit risk
articles.description: Maharashtra's monsoon may face delays this year due to the Adhik Jyeshtha month coinciding with the Super El Niño phenomenon. Historical patterns indicate a 58% likelihood of below-normal rainfall during such occurrences. This prolonged dry phase intensifies drought conditions and slows the onset of seasonal winds. Experts highlight that the monsoon's strength and distribution is affected by various factors, requiring a detailed climate analysis for accurate rainfall predictions.
